description: A card export whose paging is broken: three "pages" of six rows, each starting one row after the previous one, so 8 transactions are printed as 18 rows (the newest once, most of them three times), bank reference included. A row that repeats an earlier row cell for cell with the same reference is the same transaction listed again: it is left out and reported as repeatedInFile, and the reference still counts as one per transaction. The two COFFEE HOUSE rows of one day have a reference each and are both imported. Every cell is quoted, as that export has it. Synthetic rows.
